description: Retrieve details for a specific Jira issue by key or URL. Use this when the user mentions an issue like "PAYWALL-943" or pastes a Jira link (e.g., https://your.atlassian.net/browse/PAYWALL-943). Returns status, assignee, priority, project, type, labels, components, timestamps, and description.

issueKey.description: Issue key or full Jira URL (e.g., PROJECT-123 or https://your.atlassian.net/browse/PROJECT-123)

name: jira_get_issue
